descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B20 · 已排除（票还在 in progress / ready for pr（Quinn 10-14：不计入 bug 数））· 原 P1

Save Note 会改写重点事项：AI 失败时也已经改了（只差大小写的那条被删、没保存的草稿变成卡片）；养老院每次保存都重建 id

票：TFA-92590 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-12/S28

思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S19 「病历上有三条要点时跑 10 轮 Save Note：记录耗时、AI 时间和模型，要点不变」 Ten Save Note cycles with three points on the chart: timing, AI time and model logged, points unchanged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Save Note timing and traceability: panels expected within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles, 30 s is the upper limit for investigation; …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9；UAT 3.1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; …（TFA-92590 AC 4；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Hospital patient seeded with the S01 points, Nursing Home resident seeded with the S02 points

When Scripted Playwright loop: five Save Note cycles per mode, each with the next S10 (Hospital) / S11 (Nursing Home) note; time each tap on Save Note to the editor closing; read the backend after every cycle; read diagnostics:list

Then Panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10; any run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is flagged; each cycle has a pre-round parse row with model, durationMs and providerMs; the three points are identical to the seed after every cycle

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.5 targets are reported, not Pass/Fail (over-30 s runs go to review with Vikram). Timing comes from the scripted loop (click Save Note -> editor dialog hidden) and from diagnostics:list rows for the pre-round parse (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes, or the Nursing Home parse action): durationMs, providerMs and model (3.9 / 3.1), never from agent tool timestamps, which include m …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92590 in progress

养老院每次 Save Note 都把三条 Important Points 悄悄重建成新 id；医生看到的文字和顺序不变，10 次 Save Note 都在 15 秒内完成。

In Nursing Home every Save Note silently re-creates the three Important Points with new ids. The physician sees the same text and order, and all ten Save Notes finished within 15 s.

依据：allure b0a1cc04: in Hospital all 5 cycles keep ids, text and order; in NH the ids are re-issued every cycle. TC-12 matrix knownGap: 'Nursing Home Save Note rebuilds the cards from the editor box, one card per line, with new ids' (TFA-92590 in progress, Quinn's 10-09 audit). Timing is record-only: 8.5-10.6 s in Hospital, 5.1-6.4 s in NH, all Haiku, no fallback.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。
